title: Easy to use, but the back of the toaster gets very hot
text: Easy to use, but the back of the toaster gets very hot. [[VIDEOID:bff8d98800fcfefb09bee84ece7bd2a0]] I like the looks of this toaster and how it toast.  But, safety to me is everything.  Given the frequency that home toaster are used, and many used by older children...this could do some serious damage.  The back gets really hot and the side get very warm.  Keep this in mind, thus my 3 star rating!
